chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Sindi from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Fudayl ibn Uthman from Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki. He said:

I saw Jabir leaning on his staff, going around the pathways and gatherings of the Ansar, saying: Ali is the best of people; whoever disagrees has disbelieved. O Ansar! Raise your children upon the love of Ali; if one refuses, then look into the affair of his mother.

key_terms.أدبوا أولادكم على حب علي: Raise your children upon the love of Ali
key_terms.فانظروا في شأن أمه: Look into the affair of his mother -- an insinuation questioning the lineage/legitimacy of one who refuses

ai.seo_question: What did Jabir say about raising children upon the love of Ali?
ai.summary: Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki reports seeing Jabir ibn Abdillah leaning on his staff, going around the pathways and gatherings of the Ansar, proclaiming: 'Ali is the best of people; whoever disagrees has disbelieved. O Ansar! Raise your children upon the love of Ali; if one refuses, then look into the affair of his mother.' This hadith presents Jabir actively evangelizing Ali's virtue among the Ansar community, adding the striking instruction about child-rearing and an insinuation about those who reject Ali.
